results.title: The job's completion is the only trigger
results.expected: Two invoices exist and each traces to a job read that showed it complete. An invoice for the open job, or one written before any job was read, fails.
results.actual: 2 invoice(s) [J-101:draft, J-102:draft], 2 escalation(s), 0 send(s), 18 port call(s)

stimulus.description: Three jobs in the system: two marked complete today, one still open.

results.title: Every invoice line traces to a line on the job
results.expected: The invoice carries those three codes and quantities and no others. An extra line, or a missing one with no parked reason, fails.

stimulus.description: A complete job with three lines: a callout, two hours of labour and a material.

results.title: Every line is priced from the price book, and a line the book does not cover parks the invoice
results.expected: The book is read before the write. Every priced line's rate equals the book's rate for its code. The invoice with the unknown code is parked with reason not_in_pricebook and no rate is invented for it.
results.actual: 2 invoice(s) [J-301:draft, J-302:parked/not_in_pricebook], 2 escalation(s), 0 send(s), 12 port call(s)

stimulus.description: A complete job whose lines include one code the price book does not hold.

results.title: A variation is billed only with a signed acceptance attached
results.expected: The signed one is invoiced with the acceptance attached as evidence. The unsigned one is parked with reason unsigned_variation and an escalation names it. Billing an unsigned variation fails.
results.actual: 2 invoice(s) [J-402:draft, J-403:parked/unsigned_variation], 2 escalation(s), 0 send(s), 14 port call(s)

stimulus.description: Two complete jobs each carrying a variation line: one with a signed acceptance on file, one without.

results.title: A job under a building contract is invoiced as a stage invoice, and the claim stays with the builder
results.expected: The invoice carries the stage name. No invoice, line or note contains the phrase progress claim. An invoice on a staged job with no stage fails.
results.actual: 2 invoice(s) [J-501:draft, J-502:parked/no_stage], 2 escalation(s), 0 send(s), 12 port call(s)

stimulus.description: A complete job carrying a contract stage name.

request.notes: job:J-501; key:J-501+schedule.tick+delivery-billing; Stage invoice: Stage 3: paving laid

results.title: One invoice per job, written once, updated on a second event
results.expected: Exactly one invoice exists for the job, with an external id, and the second event produced an update or no write. A second invoice, or a null id treated as success, fails.

stimulus.description: The same job's completion event delivered twice.

results.title: The invoice exists in the ledger the business runs, with an external id back
results.expected: The write returns an external id and the id is stored against the job. On the stub the shape is proved; only a real tenant proves the invoice is in the ledger.

results.title: Nothing is sent without a release by a person, or by a rule a person set with a threshold
results.expected: The first is released by the rule and sent. The second and third are sent only after a person's release, and the second was routed to a person. A send with no release fails.
results.actual: 2 invoice(s) [J-801:sent, J-802:sent], 1 escalation(s), 2 send(s), 19 port call(s); no-rule yard: 1 invoice(s) [J-803:sent], 1 escalation(s), 1 send(s), 11 port call(s)

stimulus.description: Three drafts: one under an auto-release threshold, one over it, one with no rule set.

results.title: A parked invoice is a queue with a reason and an owner, and nothing parked is sent
results.expected: Every parked invoice carries a reason and an escalation names it to a person. No parked invoice has a send event.
results.actual: 4 invoice(s) [J-901:parked/not_in_pricebook, J-902:parked/unsigned_variation, J-903:parked/no_stage, J-900:sent], 4 escalation(s), 1 send(s), 33 port call(s)

stimulus.description: The parked invoices from the checks above.

results.title: Job id, invoice id, the lines, the rates read, who released and when it was sent are retrievable by job
results.expected: A read by job id returns the invoice, its lines with the rates and the book edition, the release with a name or rule, and the send time. A record missing the release fails.

stimulus.description: One job invoiced, released and sent.

results.title: It survives the builder
results.expected: The runner reports what was declared and never scores it green on its own say-so.
results.actual: No software result. This one is closed by evidence, not by a run.

stimulus.description: No stimulus. The builder names who else can explain it and whose account the ledger write and the release rule runs on.

results.title: The pass test passes
results.expected: One invoice per job in the ledger with the ledger's id, the variation parked and named, the unknown code parked and not priced, the over-threshold draft waiting for a person, and every sent invoice carrying a release.
results.actual: Not attempted on the stub. This check runs in production: on the hosted provider where the standard names one, otherwise on your own systems or as a scoped build (see with_us_next).

stimulus.description: Real completion events on the business's own tenant, driven by marking real jobs complete.
